value.rationale: Four consecutive movement increments are an interpretable minimum longitudinal statistic for a four-way joint cumulant. The theorem gives a complete phase diagram, warns of a precise uninformative GPS cadence, and identifies a way to distinguish covariance-identical telegraph and OU movement even with independent heavy-tailed location error. This is substantive identifiability/sampling geometry rather than an arbitrary parameter substitution; its statistical-power and field-validation limits are explicit.
